title: 'generated' of an 'optional' is refused at the call: the generator belongs on the value it wraps.
why: behavioural spec 'generated' (ADR 0085): a generator produces one value, never absence, and 'optional''s presence is the running variant's choice, which a generator would overwrite. The author writes 'optional(generated(...))'.

interaction.description: a generator on a value that may be absent
